text: Implemented invalid-state hardening. ConfoundStrategy now stores only Option[PcaRetention], with typed components/percent smart constructors and a legacy npcs/percentVariance factory for compatibility. BidsQuery, EntityFilter, BidsKind, ConfoundStrategy, and EventsTable are ordinary final classes with private Scala constructors, eliminating case-class copy/fromProduct reconstruction paths. Public query/filter construction is total. EventsTable caches validated numeric onset/duration values, and the JVM loader now exposes separate validated event-file methods with path-aware errors while preserving generic TSV readers. Verification: sbt 'bidsJVM/test' 'bidsJS/test' passed 60 JVM and 52 JS tests warning-clean; git diff --check passed; javap confirms invariant classes are no longer Products and expose no copy/unapply/fromProduct methods.
